NASB.1: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
NASB.2: 'Son of man, say to the leader of Tyre, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'Because your heart is lifted up And you have said, 'I am a god, I sit in the seat of gods In the heart of the seas'; Yet you are a man and not God, Although you make your heart like the heart of God--
NASB.3: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; There is no secret that is a match for you.
NASB.4: 'By your wisdom and understanding You have acquired riches for yourself And have acquired gold and silver for your treasuries.
NASB.5: 'By your great wisdom, by your trade You have increased your riches And your heart is lifted up because of your riches--
NASB.6: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD, 'Because you have made your heart Like the heart of God,
NASB.7: Therefore, behold, I will bring strangers upon you, The most ruthless of the nations. And they will draw their swords Against the beauty of your wisdom And defile your splendor.
NASB.8: 'They will bring you down to the pit, And you will die the death of those who are slain In the heart of the seas.
NASB.9: 'Will you still say, 'I am a god,' In the presence of your slayer, Though you are a man and not God, In the hands of those who wound you?
NASB.10: 'You will die the death of the uncircumcised By the hand of strangers, For I have spoken!' declares the Lord GOD!'''
NASB.11: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying,
NASB.12: 'Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre and say to him, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'You had the seal of perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
NASB.13: 'You were in Eden, the garden of God; Every precious stone was your covering: The ruby, the topaz and the diamond; The beryl, the onyx and the jasper; The lapis lazuli, the turquoise and the emerald; And the gold, the workmanship of your settings and sockets, Was in you. On the day that you were created They were prepared.
NASB.14: 'You were the anointed cherub who covers, And I placed you [there]. You were on the holy mountain of God; You walked in the midst of the stones of fire.
NASB.15: 'You were blameless in your ways From the day you were created Until unrighteousness was found in you.
NASB.16: 'By the abundance of your trade You were internally filled with violence, And you sinned; Therefore I have cast you as profane From the mountain of God. And I have destroyed you, O covering cherub, From the midst of the stones of fire.
NASB.17: 'Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; You corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I cast you to the ground; I put you before kings, That they may see you.
NASB.18: 'By the multitude of your iniquities, In the unrighteousness of your trade You profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought fire from the midst of you; It has consumed you, And I have turned you to ashes on the earth In the eyes of all who see you.
NASB.19: 'All who know you among the peoples Are appalled at you; You have become terrified And you will cease to be forever.'''
NASB.20: And the word of the LORD came to me saying,
NASB.21: 'Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, prophesy against her
NASB.22: and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, And I will be glorified in your midst. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments in her, And I will manifest My holiness in her.
NASB.23: 'For I will send pestilence to her And blood to her streets, And the wounded will fall in her midst By the sword upon her on every side; Then they will know that I am the LORD.
NASB.24: 'And there will be no more for the house of Israel a prickling brier or a painful thorn from any round about them who scorned them; then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'
NASB.25: 'Thus says the Lord GOD, 'When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and will manifest My holiness in them in the sight of the nations, then they will live in their land which I gave to My servant Jacob.
NASB.26: 'They will live in it securely; and they will build houses, plant vineyards and live securely when I execute judgments upon all who scorn them round about them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.'''

NKJV.1: The word of the LORD came to me again, saying,
NKJV.2: “Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Because your heart is lifted up, And you say, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of gods, In the midst of the seas,’ Yet you are a man, and not a god, Though you set your heart as the heart of a god
NKJV.3: (Behold, you are wiser than Daniel! There is no secret that can be hidden from you!
NKJV.4: With your wisdom and your understanding You have gained riches for yourself, And gathered gold and silver into your treasuries;
NKJV.5: By your great wisdom in trade you have increased your riches, And your heart is lifted up because of your riches),”
NKJV.6: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: “Because you have set your heart as the heart of a god,
NKJV.7: Behold, therefore, I will bring strangers against you,  The most terrible of the nations; And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, And defile your splendor.
NKJV.8: They shall throw you down into the Pit, And you shall die the death of the slain In the midst of the seas.
NKJV.9: “Will you still say before him who slays you, ‘I am a god’? But you shall be a man, and not a god, In the hand of him who slays you.
NKJV.10: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised By the hand of aliens; For I have spoken,” says the Lord GOD.’ ”
NKJV.11: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
NKJV.12: “Son of man, take up a lamentation for the king of Tyre, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “You were the seal of perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
NKJV.13: You were in Eden, the garden of God; Every precious stone was your covering: The sardius, topaz, and diamond, Beryl, onyx, and jasper, Sapphire, turquoise, and emerald with gold. The workmanship of your timbrels and pipes Was prepared for you on the day you were created.
NKJV.14: “You were the anointed cherub who covers; I established you; You were on the holy mountain of God; You walked back and forth in the midst of fiery stones.
NKJV.15: You were perfect in your ways from the day you were created, Till iniquity was found in you.
NKJV.16: “By the abundance of your trading You became filled with violence within, And you sinned; Therefore I cast you as a profane thing Out of the mountain of God; And I destroyed you, O covering cherub, From the midst of the fiery stones.
NKJV.17: “Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; You corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor; I cast you to the ground, I laid you before kings, That they might gaze at you.
NKJV.18: “You defiled your sanctuaries By the multitude of your iniquities, By the iniquity of your trading; Therefore I brought fire from your midst; It devoured you, And I turned you to ashes upon the earth In the sight of all who saw you.
NKJV.19: All who knew you among the peoples are astonished at you; You have become a horror, And shall be no more forever.” ’ ”
NKJV.20: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
NKJV.21: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her,
NKJV.22: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, I am against you, O Sidon; I will be glorified in your midst; And they shall know that I am the LORD, When I execute judgments in her and am hallowed in her.
NKJV.23: For I will send pestilence upon her, And blood in her streets; The wounded shall be judged in her midst By the sword against her on every side; Then they shall know that I am the LORD.
NKJV.24: “And there shall no longer be a pricking brier or a painful thorn for the house of Israel from among all who are around them, who despise them. Then they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.”
NKJV.25: ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am hallowed in them in the sight of the Gentiles, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to My servant Jacob.
NKJV.26: And they will dwell safely there, build houses, and plant vineyards; yes, they will dwell securely, when I execute judgments on all those around them who despise them. Then they shall know that I am the LORD their God.” ’ ”

ESV.1: The word of the LORD came to me:
ESV.2: “Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord GOD: “Because your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of the gods, in the heart of the seas,’ yet you are but a man, and no god, though you make your heart like the heart of a god —
ESV.3: you are indeed wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you;
ESV.4: by your wisdom and your understanding you have made wealth for yourself, and have gathered gold and silver into your treasuries;
ESV.5: by your great wisdom in your trade you have increased your wealth, and your heart has become proud in your wealth —
ESV.6: therefore thus says the Lord GOD: Because you make your heart like the heart of a god,
ESV.7: therefore, behold, I will bring foreigners upon you, the most ruthless of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your splendor.
ESV.8: They shall thrust you down into the pit, and you shall die the death of the slain in the heart of the seas.
ESV.9: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who kill you, though you are but a man, and no god, in the hands of those who slay you?
ESV.10: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners; for I have spoken, declares the Lord GOD.”
ESV.11: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me:
ESV.12: “Son of man, raise a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him, Thus says the Lord GOD: “You were the signet of perfection,  full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
ESV.13: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering, sardius, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire,  emerald, and carbuncle; and crafted in gold were your settings and your engravings.  On the day that you were created they were prepared.
ESV.14: You were an anointed guardian cherub. I placed you;  you were on the holy mountain of God; in the midst of the stones of fire you walked.
ESV.15: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, till unrighteousness was found in you.
ESV.16: In the abundance of your trade you were filled with violence in your midst, and you sinned; so I cast you as a profane thing from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you,  O guardian cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
ESV.17: Your heart was proud because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor. I cast you to the ground; I exposed you before kings, to feast their eyes on you.
ESV.18: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your trade you profaned your sanctuaries; so I brought fire out from your midst; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all who saw you.
ESV.19: All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have come to a dreadful end and shall be no more forever.”
ESV.20: The word of the LORD came to me:
ESV.21: “Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her
ESV.22: and say, Thus says the Lord GOD: “Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will manifest my glory in your midst. And they shall know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments in her and manifest my holiness in her;
ESV.23: for I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the slain shall fall in her midst, by the sword that is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
ESV.24: “And for the house of Israel there shall be no more a brier to prick or a thorn to hurt them among all their neighbors who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.
ESV.25: “Thus says the Lord GOD: When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and manifest my holiness in them in the sight of the nations, then they shall dwell in their own land that I gave to my servant Jacob.
ESV.26: And they shall dwell securely in it, and they shall build houses and plant vineyards. They shall dwell securely, when I execute judgments upon all their neighbors who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.”

WEB.1: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,
WEB.2: Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas; yet you are man, and not God, though you set your heart as the heart of God —
WEB.3: behold, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from you;
WEB.4: by your wisdom and by your understanding you have gotten yourself riches, and have gotten gold and silver into your treasures;
WEB.5: by your great wisdom and by your traffic you have increased your riches, and your heart is lifted up because of your riches —
WEB.6: therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because you have set your heart as the heart of God,
WEB.7: therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you, the terrible of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they shall defile your brightness.
WEB.8: They shall bring you down to the pit; and you shall die the death of those who are slain, in the heart of the seas.
WEB.9: Will you yet say before him who kills you, I am God? but you are man, and not God, in the hand of him who wounds you.
WEB.10: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, says the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.11: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
WEB.12: Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: You were the seal of full measure, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
WEB.13: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper, sapphire,  turquoise, and beryl. Gold work of tambourines and of pipes was in you. In the day that you were created they were prepared.
WEB.14: You were the anointed cherub who covers: and I set you, so that you were on the holy mountain of God; you have walked up and down in the middle of the stones of fire.
WEB.15: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, until unrighteousness was found in you.
WEB.16: By the abundance of your traffic they filled your insides with violence, and you have sinned: therefore I have cast you as profane out of the mountain of God; and I have destroyed you, covering cherub, from the middle of the stones of fire.
WEB.17: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; you have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your brightness: I have cast you to the ground; I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.
WEB.18: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your traffic, you have profaned your sanctuaries; therefore I have brought out a fire from the middle of you; it has devoured you, and I have turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all those who see you.
WEB.19: All those who know you among the peoples shall be astonished at you: you have become a terror, and you shall exist no more.
WEB.20: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
WEB.21: Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against it,
WEB.22: and say, Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I am against you, Sidon; and I will be glorified among you; and they shall know that I am Yahweh, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
WEB.23: For I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall fall within her, with the sword on her on every side; and they shall know that I am Yahweh.
WEB.24: There shall be no more a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them, that scorned them; and they shall know that I am the Lord Yahweh.
WEB.25: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the nations, then shall they dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.
WEB.26: They shall dwell securely therein; yes, they shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and shall dwell securely, when I have executed judgments on all those who do them despite all around them; and they shall know that I am Yahweh their God.

NLT.1: Then this message came to me from the LORD:
NLT.2:
“Son of man, give the prince of Tyre this message from the Sovereign LORD: “In your great pride you claim, ‘I am a god!
I sit on a divine throne in the heart of the sea.’
But you are only a man and not a god,
though you boast that you are a god.
NLT.3:
You regard yourself as wiser than Daniel
and think no secret is hidden from you.
NLT.4:
With your wisdom and understanding you have amassed great wealth —
gold and silver for your treasuries.
NLT.5:
Yes, your wisdom has made you very rich,
and your riches have made you very proud.

NET.10: You will die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners; for I have spoken, declares the sovereign LORD.’”
NET.11: The word of the LORD came to me:
NET.12: “Son of man, sing a lament for the king of Tyre, and say to him, ‘This is what the sovereign LORD says: “‘You were the sealer of perfection, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
NET.13: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone was your covering, the ruby, topaz, and emerald, the chrysolite, onyx, and jasper, the sapphire, turquoise, and beryl; your settings and mounts were made of gold. On the day you were created they were prepared.
NET.14: I placed you there with an anointed guardian cherub; you were on the holy mountain of God; you walked about amidst fiery stones.
NET.15: You were blameless in your behavior from the day you were created, until sin was discovered in you.
NET.16: In the abundance of your trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned; so I defiled you and banished you from the mountain of God — the guardian cherub expelled you from the midst of the stones of fire.
NET.17: Your heart was proud because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your splendor. I threw you down to the ground; I placed you before kings, that they might see you.
NET.18: By the multitude of your iniquities, through the sinfulness of your trade, you desecrated your sanctuaries. So I drew fire out from within you; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes on the earth before the eyes of all who saw you.
NET.19: All who know you among the peoples are shocked at you; you have become terrified and will be no more.’”
NET.20: The word of the LORD came to me:
NET.21: “Son of man, turn toward Sidon and prophesy against it.
NET.22: Say, ‘This is what the sovereign LORD says: “‘Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will magnify myself in your midst. Then they will know that I am the LORD when I execute judgments on her and reveal my sovereign power in her.
NET.23: I will send a plague into the city and bloodshed into its streets; the slain will fall within it, by the sword that attacks it from every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
NET.24: “‘No longer will Israel suffer from the sharp briers or painful thorns of all who surround and scorn them. Then they will know that I am the sovereign LORD.
NET.25: “‘This is what the sovereign LORD says: When I regather the house of Israel from the peoples where they are dispersed, I will reveal my sovereign power over them in the sight of the nations, and they will live in their land that I gave to my servant Jacob.
NET.26: They will live securely in it; they will build houses and plant vineyards. They will live securely when I execute my judgments on all those who scorn them and surround them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.’”
